*Website developed with R and Git*

I have always been fascinated by the way machines can be trained to make decisions and solve complex problems. My journey into machine learning began during my master's studies, where I delved deeper into data science and artificial intelligence through coursework and hands-on projects. Over time, I became passionate about how these technologies could revolutionize industries, from healthcare to finance. My ultimate goal is to contribute to the development of scalable and equitable AI systems that can improve human lives by automating decision-making and unlocking hidden patterns in data. I am particularly excited about deep learning and natural language processing, as I believe they hold the potential for creating transformative solutions in fields such as healthcare diagnostics and personalized education.

I will highlight a selection of projects that demonstrate my expertise in machine learning and AI. Each project reflects my hands-on experience in solving real-world problems and applying various techniques in the field.

__Projects__

* Airbnb Rental Price prediction (Python, R): This project predicts Airbnb rental prices in New York City based on data from 2017. 

* Hot Summer Trends (R, Git): This project analyzes weather changes in Boston based on data from 2023
